sections.title: Hotel Check-in · 6 步入住对话
sections.instructions: 按顺序完成对话。每题只写住客要说的一句；系统接受多种自然表达。

items.prompt: Front desk: “Good evening. Welcome to the Maple Hotel. How can I help you?” 任务：告诉前台你想办理入住。

scene.speaker: FRONT DESK
scene.cue: Good evening. Welcome to the Maple Hotel. How can I help you?
scene.translation: 晚上好。欢迎来到枫叶酒店。有什么可以帮您？
scene.task: 告诉前台你想办理入住。

items.canonicalAnswer: I'd like to check in, please.
answers: I'd like to check in, please.
I would like to check in, please.
I would like to check in.
I want to check in, please.
I am here to check in.
items.polishNote: 意思已经表达清楚；更自然、礼貌的说法是：I'd like to check in, please.
items.ambiguityNote: 接受表达入住意图或说明已有预订的自然回答。

items.prompt: Front desk: “What name is the reservation under?” 任务：告诉前台预订登记在 Chen 名下。

scene.speaker: FRONT DESK
scene.cue: What name is the reservation under?
scene.translation: 请问预订登记在哪个名字下？
scene.task: 告诉前台预订登记在 Chen 名下。

items.canonicalAnswer: The reservation is under the name Chen.
items.answerTranslation: 预订登记在 Chen 名下。
answers: It is under the name Chen.
The reservation is under the name Chen.
My reservation is under the name Chen.
I have a reservation under Chen.
I have a reservation under the name Chen.
I have a booking under Chen.
I have a booking under the name Chen.
items.polishNote: 意思已经表达清楚；完整说法可以是：The reservation is under the name Chen.
items.ambiguityNote: 直接回答姓名，或使用 reservation / booking 的完整句子都可以。

items.prompt: Front desk: “May I see your passport, please?” 任务：把护照递给前台。

scene.speaker: FRONT DESK
scene.cue: May I see your passport, please?
scene.translation: 可以看一下您的护照吗？

items.polishNote: 意思已经表达清楚；递交物品时可以说：Sure. Here you are.
items.ambiguityNote: 接受表示同意并递交证件的常见自然表达。

items.prompt: Front desk: “You booked a double room for two nights. Breakfast is included.” 任务：询问几点退房。

scene.speaker: FRONT DESK
scene.cue: You booked a double room for two nights. Breakfast is included.
scene.translation: 您预订的是双人房，入住两晚，含早餐。

answers: What time do I need to check out?
When do I need to check out?
What time should I check out?
When do I have to check out?
What time do we check out?
items.polishNote: 意思已经表达清楚；更自然的问法是：What time is checkout?
items.ambiguityNote: checkout 是名词；check out 是动词短语，两种结构都接受。

items.prompt: Front desk: “Checkout is at 11 a.m. Your room is 508, on the fifth floor. Here is your key card.” 任务：询问酒店 Wi-Fi 密码。

scene.speaker: FRONT DESK
scene.cue: Checkout is at 11 a.m. Your room is 508, on the fifth floor. Here is your key card.
scene.translation: 上午 11 点退房。您的房间是 508，在五楼。这是您的房卡。
scene.task: 询问酒店 Wi-Fi 密码。

items.canonicalAnswer: Could I have the Wi-Fi password, please?
items.answerTranslation: 可以告诉我 Wi-Fi 密码吗？
answers: Could I have the Wi-Fi password, please?
Can I have the Wi-Fi password, please?
May I have the Wi-Fi password, please?
Could I get the Wi-Fi password, please?
Can I get the Wi-Fi password, please?
Could you tell me the Wi-Fi password, please?
Can you tell me the Wi-Fi password, please?
items.polishNote: 意思表达正确；询问密码时通常要加 the。更自然的说法是：What is the Wi-Fi password?
items.ambiguityNote: 接受 could / can / may，以及 Wi-Fi、WiFi、Wi Fi 等常见写法。

items.prompt: Front desk: “The Wi-Fi password is MAPLE508. Is there anything else?” 任务：表示没有别的问题并道谢。

scene.speaker: FRONT DESK
scene.cue: The Wi-Fi password is MAPLE508. Is there anything else?
scene.translation: Wi-Fi 密码是 MAPLE508。还需要别的帮助吗？
scene.task: 表示没有别的问题并道谢。

answers: I am all set, thank you.
items.polishNote: 意思已经表达清楚；可以说：No, that's all. Thank you.
items.ambiguityNote: 接受表示不需要其他帮助并礼貌结束对话的自然回答。
